title: Align CommandCenterUI composer controls with message dropdown
description: Align the message text field and Send button with the message-type dropdown rather than the helper text beneath it, while retaining the compact helper copy. Superseded by TASK-254, which owns independent review and release of the combined final UI state because later serial edits overwrote the earlier worktree snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Composer text field and Send button align with the message-type dropdown, not its helper text.
Live and installer styles remain equivalent and focused checks pass.
